entry.title: dotnet/SqlClient - Releases - 2026-11-13
entry.content:
Stable Release v7.0.4

This servicing release includes security updates, certificate and enclave-session validation fixes, and improvements to result reading and managed networking.

Use matching 7.0.4 versions of the driver and companion packages. Assemblies retain AssemblyVersion 7.0.0.0; no new .NET Framework binding redirects are required when upgrading from 7.0.3. Microsoft.SqlServer.Server is unchanged and versioned independently.

Changes Since 7.0.3

Changed

  • Updated dependencies to address CVE-2026-84008: System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs 8.0.2 for net462/net8.0/netstandard2.0 and affected .NET 9 dependencies to 9.0.21.
  • Updated native SNI dependencies to 6.0.4.
  • Updated user-agent telemetry to v2 and added compatibility-switch reporting. Async behavior and switch defaults are unchanged.

Fixed

  • Enforced an explicit HostNameInCertificate during managed SNI certificate validation, even when the certificate matches the server name (net8.0/net9.0). (#4908)
  • Isolated Always Encrypted enclave-session cache entries by attestation protocol. (#4867)
  • Fixed unobserved receive exceptions and packet cleanup when closing managed SNI connections with MARS reads pending (net8.0/net9.0). (#4950)
  • Fixed SqlDataReader.HasRows returning false when informational messages precede the first row. (#4899)
  • Fixed statistics timer races throwing "Nullable object must have a value." Connection and MARS use remain non-thread-safe. (#4897)
  • Fixed sequential GetTextReader reads corrupting nvarchar text on big-endian platforms. (#4962)
  • Rejected malformed PRELOGIN responses with a corrupted-stream error instead of IndexOutOfRangeException. (#4978)
  • Rejected row, alternate-result, and authentication responses missing required metadata or state, and prevented affected connections from returning to the pool. (#4982)

Companion Packages

All packages below ship as 7.0.4.

Package Highlights
Extensions.Azure Added actionable guidance for Windows WAM window_handle_required errors, preserving the original error code and inner exception.
AlwaysEncrypted.AzureKeyVaultProvider Version alignment only; no functional or API changes.
Extensions.Abstractions Version alignment only; no functional or API changes.
Internal.Logging Version alignment only; internal use, not for direct application references.

For Windows WAM errors, provide a parent window through SetParentActivityOrWindowFunc, or use Authentication=Active Directory Default with a configured non-interactive credential in windowless hosts. Interactive authentication without WAM requires a custom ApplicationClientId and UseWamBroker=false. WAM remains enforced for SqlClient's first-party application ID; no automatic fallback was added.

Platform Support

.NET Framework 4.6.2+ on Windows and .NET 8.0+ on Windows, Linux, and macOS. Companion package targets and dependency lists are included in the linked package notes.

Thanks to LaurensVergote for contributing.

Stable Release v7.1.2

This servicing release includes security updates, certificate and enclave-session validation fixes, and improvements to result reading and managed networking.

Changes Since 7.1.1

Changed

  • Updated dependencies to address CVE-2026-84008: System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs 8.0.2 for net462/net8.0/netstandard2.0 and affected .NET 9 dependencies, including System.Threading.RateLimiting, to 9.0.21.
  • Updated native SNI dependencies to 7.1.2.
  • Added user-agent reporting for async and SNI compatibility switches. Async behavior and switch defaults are unchanged.

Fixed

  • Enforced an explicit HostNameInCertificate during managed SNI certificate validation, even when the certificate matches the server name (net8.0/net9.0). (#4907)
  • Isolated Always Encrypted enclave-session cache entries by attestation protocol. (#4866)
  • Fixed unobserved receive exceptions and packet cleanup when closing managed SNI connections with MARS reads pending (net8.0/net9.0). (#4951)
  • Fixed SqlDataReader.HasRows returning false when informational messages precede the first row. (#4900)
  • Fixed statistics timer races throwing "Nullable object must have a value." Connection and MARS use remain non-thread-safe. (#4895)
  • Fixed sequential GetTextReader reads corrupting nvarchar text on big-endian platforms. (#4961)
  • Rejected malformed PRELOGIN responses with a corrupted-stream error instead of IndexOutOfRangeException. (#4977)
  • Rejected row, alternate-result, and authentication responses missing required metadata or state, and prevented affected connections from returning to the pool. (#4983)
  • Fixed eager Windows native SNI initialization causing TypeInitializationException or DllNotFoundException on Unix (net8.0/net9.0). (#4770)

Companion Packages

All packages below ship as 7.1.2.

Package Highlights
Extensions.Azure Added actionable guidance for Windows WAM window_handle_required errors, preserving the original error code and inner exception.
AlwaysEncrypted.AzureKeyVaultProvider Version alignment only; no functional or API changes.
Extensions.Abstractions Version alignment only; no functional or API changes.
Internal.Logging Version alignment only; internal use, not for direct application references.

For Windows WAM errors, provide a parent window through SetParentActivityOrWindowFunc, or use Authentication=Active Directory Default with a configured non-interactive credential in windowless hosts. Interactive authentication without WAM requires a custom ApplicationClientId and UseWamBroker=false. WAM remains enforced for SqlClient's first-party application ID; no automatic fallback was added.

Platform Support

.NET Framework 4.6.2+ on Windows and .NET 8.0+ on Windows, Linux, and macOS. Companion package targets and dependency lists are included in the linked package notes.
